reader.requirement: At --std 85, when the ALPHABET clause's literal phrase is used, each character may be specified at most once across the whole clause, whether written as a nonnumeric literal (single or multi-character), a numeric ordinal, a THRU range (either direction), an ALSO member, or a figurative constant (SPACE, ZERO, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE); any repetition must be refused and a clause of distinct characters accepted.

IS LOCALE binds nothing below 2002 (Edition.DialectLevel < 2002); not on the literal-phrase path

EXIT 65; COBOL1906 U+0020 (SPACE " "); ZERO "0", QUOTE """", HIGH-VALUE 65536 (U+FFFF), LOW-VALUE 1 (U+0000) likewise
probes.expected: refused: a figurative constant specifies its character

probes.printed: EXIT 0; REVERSED ("Z" "Y" "A" as program collating sequence)
